# AcademyPro

> Academy management software for pickleball and padel coaches, plus a player training app with certified-coach programs and session logbooks.

AcademyPro helps solo coaches and multi-location academies run unified curriculum, manage coaches, track student progress, and grow revenue. Players use the same platform to follow rating-matched programs and log every session. Available on iOS, Android, and web.

## Main pages

- [For Academies](https://academypro.thecourtflow.com/): Homepage for coaches and academy owners — pricing, features, and onboarding
- [For Players](https://academypro.thecourtflow.com/players): Player-focused landing page — programs, logbook, and app download

## Downloads

- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/picklepro-pickleball-hero/id6753142959): Download AcademyPro for iPhone and iPad
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.picklepro.mobile): Download AcademyPro for Android
